test_host_env: test that environment variables are correctly passed to an MRP Host process and captured in its output
define_mrp_process: define an MRP process with a Host runtime, custom command, and environment variables using mrp.process
create_mrp_host_runtime: create an MRP Host runtime that executes a shell command like env using mrp.Host
start_mrp_process: start an MRP process by name and reset its logs using mrp.cmd.up
wait_for_mrp_process: wait for an MRP process to complete execution using mrp.cmd.wait
